Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence.balance

Class KfeBalanceService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence.balance.KfeBalanceService
@Service public class KfeBalanceService extends Object
Persists KFE balance transitions under row locks, refreshes integrity hashes, and emits UI snapshots. All arithmetic and transitions delegate to KfeBalanceEntity; this adapter also preserves observed-chain state separately from spendable buckets and isolates event publication failures.

    • creditObserved

      public KfeBalanceEntity creditObserved(UUID walletId, String asset, long amountSats)
      Increments observed balance for compatibility with legacy callers. Prefer setObserved(java.util.UUID, java.lang.String, long) with an absolute chain probe for WATCH_ONLY/CUSTODIAL_ONCHAIN.
      Parameters:
      walletId - wallet receiving the observation increment
      asset - asset code
      amountSats - positive increment in satoshis
      Returns:
      saved balance after increment
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when amountSats is not positive
      ArithmeticException - when the resulting balance overflows

    • zeroSpendableBucketsIfNeeded

      public KfeBalanceEntity zeroSpendableBucketsIfNeeded(UUID walletId, String asset)
      Ensures a watch-only wallet has no available, pending, locked, or auto-hold spendable balance. If any bucket is nonzero, it clears all four, increments the entity version, re-signs, and saves.
      Parameters:
      walletId - watch-only wallet identifier
      asset - asset code
      Returns:
      unchanged locked row when already zeroed, otherwise saved cleared row
